verdict.rationale: The annual-return page names delegated roles, "full access manager" and "filing collaborator", plus a corporation key and a "Manage shared access and permissions" page. The fee schedule refers to a "registered intermediary" filing route. Together these show a delegated-access model exists, but nothing in the pack spells out what each role may or may not do. missing for 10: published authorization/consent forms for third parties, a documented scope of permissions per role, which signatures or attestations must stay personal to directors, and independent corroboration.
